gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired Canto IX part 1/2 records. Guide aliases for Training to Inherit the Name of a Star and Armor of Protection & Repression are resolved by their passive IDs; spacing, Roman numeral, and Effloresced E.G.O variants use matching status or passive records. Sora's Let These Hands be the Proxy... follows the enemy skill rather than the Identity variant. Mang follows passive 999907. The Ren/Albina withdrawal thresholds, distinct-skill weakening, shared Sora HP pool, and NPC support conditions are retained.

lead.text: Prevent hits on the Prescript's target early; later, survive with Vespa's support. Prioritize more than damage: use Ryōshū's resources and healing while preserving Assist Defense's conditions.

listLead.text: Prevent hits on the Prescript's Target early, then survive with allied NPC support later. Use Ryōshū's resource generation and healing rather than pursuing damage alone, and maintain the Assist Defense conditions.

statNote.text: Normal 9-30. Only Yi Sang, Ryōshū, Meursault, and Gregor may deploy; Ryōshū is required. Normal and Effloresced forms are states of the same enemy, not separate 1500-HP fights. Offense/Defense entries are before Grace of the Prescript, Unlock, Faith Beyond Question, Shin (心) - Sora, and other buffs. Gains 750 Shield at encounter start and another 750 when Vespa joins.

skillNote.text: Lists normal and Effloresced skills separately. “Please Don't Resist and just be Crushed to Death” is outside 9-30's normal pattern. Check effects for conditional Unbreakable Coins.

priorities.0.text: Have the Prescript's target handle Sloth skills; redirect other attacks to different Sinners.

priorities.1.text: Use Ryōshū's resources for healing/debuffs and survive until the event.

priorities.2.text: For attacks left to Vespa's Assist Defense, preserve the one-sided-attack and no-defense-equipped conditions.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Enemy SP and Power keep rising early

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Hits on the Prescript's target make completion easier. That target should clash against Sloth skills while others redirect remaining attacks. Failed Prescripts still add Grace and Onus; progression cannot be halted forever.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: Sinners die even after Vespa arrives

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: The NPC does not automatically block everything. Stop the remaining 2 attacks with Sinners. Equipping defense on a target intended for Assist Defense invalidates its condition.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Evade is equipped but never activates

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: “I-I Have to Execute the Prescript Soon...!” prevents defense-skill activation. At 2 Onus, it also cannot be redirected; prepare a winning attack on the designated Sinner.

units.0.speed.text: 1–2 / +10 on powerful-attack turns and other bonuses

units.0.notes.0.text: Unlock progresses at 3/6/9 Grace or at 90%/75%/60% HP. Progress restores SP to 45 and clears Stagger.

units.0.notes.1.text: Before Unlock, even failed Prescripts grant 1 Grace. Do not infer the opening state only from a fixed turn count.

units.1.speed.text: 1–2 plus Faith Beyond Question, Shin (心) - Sora, and other bonuses

units.1.stagger.text: No regular thresholds / Stagger from specific effects

units.1.notes.0.text: With Unlock and 25+ SP at Turn Start, spend 15 SP to Effloresce. Ends at Turn Start with 0 SP or lower.

units.1.notes.1.text: After Vespa joins, Annihilation Form prevents SP falling below 0 and adds Shield and buffs.

units.1.notes.2.text: At 300 HP, enters the closing pattern and Vespa delivers the finish. Sinners do not need to reduce HP to 0.

phases.0.title.text: Prioritize survival and healing for all 4 Sinners

phases.0.steps.0.text: Recommended Level 60. Level Yi Sang, Ryōshū, Meursault, and Gregor. If no other ally lives, Ryōshū loses protection from lethal damage.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Bring HP/SP recovery and Attack Power Down. Ryōshū generates resources by using skills; use options such as Meursault's Chains of Others to weaken strong attacks.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Normal form is vulnerable to Pierce; Efflorescence resists all 3 physical types. Gloom and Pride work well afterward. Prioritize necessary clashes and healing over raw damage.

phases.1.title.text: Prevent repeated hits on the Prescript's target

phases.1.steps.0.text: Check The Prescript's Target - The Index each turn. Conditions change by stage: Prescript I requires a hit on the target, II a hit from the first slot, and so on.

phases.1.steps.1.text: The designated target should handle Sloth skills such as “Skull Crushing” while other Sinners redirect remaining attacks. “I-I Have to Execute the Prescript Soon...!” disables defense; do not rely on Evade against it.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Preventing completion stops the 15 SP recovery but increases Onus and Karmic Consequence. Before Unlock, Grace also rises by 1; repeated failure does not prevent Efflorescence forever.

phases.2.title.text: Endure with healing/debuffs until turn 8 or 900 HP

phases.2.steps.0.text: Meeting Unlock/SP conditions causes Efflorescence; regular skills become Slash too. Faith Beyond Question and Poise strengthen attacks beyond base values, so use current predictions each turn.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Ryōshū removes Stagger Thresholds even from damage that would Stagger her, and can fight with next-turn attack buffs and resource gains. Preserve allied HP and choose which attacks she redirects.

phases.2.steps.2.text: An event at turn 8's start or 900 HP brings Vespa. Reach it through healing and debuffs rather than forcing a kill. Before he joins, lowering SP to end Efflorescence is another option.

phases.3.title.text: Separate Assist Defense assignments from Sinner clashes

phases.3.steps.0.text: Of the basic 6 attacks, Vespa clashes against the rightmost 3. Leave the far-left attack to Assist Defense; stop the middle 2 with Ryōshū or other Sinners. Check that the NPC actually has the intended targets.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Assist Defense intercepts one-sided attacks on allies without defense skills equipped. Do not clash against that attack or equip defense on its target. Defense in another slot of that same Sinner also affects eligibility.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Vespa can lose clashes, and losing all Sinners causes defeat. Unlock III's finisher can be clashed regardless of Speed, but avoid needlessly redirecting NPC assignments.

phases.4.steps.0.text: Procuration's Immanent Yearning variant prioritizes Vespa. It has 5 Unbreakable Coins and lacks the 90% clash-loss damage reduction of ordinary “Procuration: Annihilate”. Confirm it remains assigned to Vespa.

phases.4.steps.1.text: It ends the turn after attacking; heal beforehand rather than relying on later actions. At 300 HP, the closing sequence ends with Vespa's “Harpoon Impalement - There It Is.”

skills.0.response.text: Poise and target Sinking raise Power above the display. Redirect away from the Prescript's target to prevent hits and completion.

skills.2.name.text: I-I Have to Execute the Prescript Soon...!

skills.2.effects.2.text: Final Power +1 per 6 total own Poise and target Sinking (max 3)

skills.2.effects.5.text: [On Use] Gain 2 Poise and 2 Poise Count

skills.2.effects.8.text: Ⅱ[On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Sinking Count +2

skills.3.name.text: Please Don't Resist and just be Crushed to Death

skills.3.effects.0.text: Can be clashed regardless of Speed

skills.3.effects.1.text: [On Clash Lose] Gain 3 Power Down and 4 Paralyze

skills.3.effects.2.text: [On Clash Lose] Damage -90%; hits cannot Stagger targets or trigger Sinking

skills.3.effects.5.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Gain 1 Poise

skills.3.effects.7.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Gain 1 Poise

skills.4.name.text: Let These Hands be the Proxy...

skills.4.effects.0.text: Final Power +1 per 6 total own Poise and target Sinking (max 2)

skills.4.response.text: The Effloresced Sloth skill. Have the Prescript's target clash here while others redirect remaining attacks. Enemy SP falls by 3 after attacking.

skills.5.effects.0.text: Final Power +1 per 6 total own Poise and target Sinking (max 2)

skills.5.effects.1.text: [Combat Start] With Onus or against The Prescript's Target - The Index, the final Coin becomes Unbreakable

skills.5.effects.2.text: [On Clash Lose] Damage -50%; hits cannot Stagger targets or trigger Sinking

skills.5.effects.7.text: Ⅲ[On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Sinking Count +2

skills.5.response.text: The last Coin is conditionally Unbreakable. Include Poise, target Sinking, and Efflorescence buffs in predictions. Use the clash-loss damage halving and Sinking prevention.

skills.6.effects.0.text: Coin Power +1 per 6 total own Poise and target Sinking (max 2)

skills.6.effects.1.text: [Combat Start] With Onus or against The Prescript's Target - The Index, the final Coin becomes Unbreakable

skills.6.effects.2.text: [On Use] Against The Prescript's Target - The Index, damage +50%

skills.6.effects.3.text: [On Use] Gain 3 Poise and 3 Poise Count

skills.6.effects.4.text: [On Clash Lose] Damage -80%; hits cannot Stagger targets or activate Sinking

skills.6.effects.6.text: Ⅰ[On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 3 Sinking

skills.6.effects.7.text: Ⅱ[On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Sinking Count +3

skills.6.response.text: Deals +50% damage to the Prescript's target; Poise and Sinking also raise Coin Power. Winning grants 80% reduction and prevents Stagger/Sinking from those hits. Do not ignore dangerous attacks left after Vespa joins.

skills.7.effects.0.text: Can be clashed regardless of Speed

skills.7.effects.1.text: [On Use] Against The Prescript's Target - The Index, damage +100%

skills.7.effects.2.text: [On Clash Lose] Gain 3 Power Down and 4 Paralyze

skills.7.effects.3.text: [On Clash Lose] Damage -90%; hits cannot Stagger targets or trigger Sinking

skills.7.effects.7.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Sinking

skills.7.effects.9.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Sinking

skills.7.effects.11.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Sinking

skills.7.effects.13.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Sinking

skills.7.response.text: 4 Unbreakable Coins, clashable regardless of Speed. Win with high Power for 90% damage reduction and 4 Paralyze. Unlike Immanent Yearning, this skill has substantial clash-loss mitigation.

skills.8.name.text: Procuration: Annihilation - Mang of Immanent Yearning [本望]

skills.8.effects.0.text: [On Use] At 0 SP or higher, generate 1 Mang

skills.8.effects.1.text: - Damage +20%; Final Power and Coin Power +2 each

skills.8.effects.3.text: [After Attack] If a Mang was generated, consume 20 SP

skills.8.effects.4.text: [After Attack] Consume all Onus and end the turn

skills.8.response.text: 5 Unbreakable Coins. At 0 SP or higher, generates Mang and gains +2 Final Power and Coin Power. Unlike other Annihilate skills, it has no clash-loss damage reduction. Avoid redirecting it away from Vespa; also account for the turn ending afterward.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Ryōshū gains +1 slot and +10% damage against Spiderweb. Damage that would Stagger removes her Stagger Thresholds and grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn (once per turn). Skill use grants 1 resource matching the skill and 1 of a scarce affinity (twice per turn). Cannot retreat.

mechanics.0.response.text: Ryōshū cannot die while another ally lives. Spend resources on healing and enemy debuffs while protecting allies too.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Skill Power -2 against the Index; damage taken +20%. Becomes Sora's priority target.

mechanics.1.response.text: Redirect attacks with other Sinners to avoid concentrating hits on the marked Sinner.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Completed by hitting the Prescript's target. Granted without Unlock; Grace gained through this Prescript caps at 3.

mechanics.2.response.text: Redirect to other Sinners and prevent hits.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Completed by hitting the Prescript's target with the first slot's skill or killing the target. Granted at Unlock I; Grace caps at 6.

mechanics.3.response.text: Check the first slot and designated target together; prioritize necessary clashes.

mechanics.4.effect.text: Completed by Staggering or killing the target. Granted at Unlock II; Grace caps at 9.

mechanics.4.response.text: Heal low-HP Sinners or those near Stagger, and stop strong attacks.

mechanics.5.effect.text: A Prescript to eliminate every obstacle. Granted at Unlock III.

mechanics.5.response.text: Later, prioritize NPC support and survival rather than only preventing Prescript completion.

mechanics.6.effect.text: Max 9. Offense Level +1 per 3. Unlock progresses at 3/6/9.

mechanics.6.response.text: HP conditions also advance stages; do not assess progression from Grace alone.

mechanics.7.effect.text: Offense/Defense Levels +1; heal 15 SP at Combat End. II grants +2 and 30 SP; III grants +3 and 45 SP.

mechanics.7.response.text: Check the current Unlock stage against base values.

mechanics.8.effect.text: Max 2. Damage +25% per stack. While Effloresced, Final Power +1 at 1 stack, or +3 at 2 instead.

mechanics.8.response.text: Preventing Prescripts still strengthens the enemy. At high Onus, prepare for skills that cannot be redirected.

mechanics.9.effect.text: Max 2. Damage +50% per stack. While Effloresced, 1 stack grants +2 Final Power; 2 grant +1 Plus Coin Power and +3 Final Power. Certain skills consume this as Onus.

mechanics.9.response.text: Substantial buffs after Vespa joins. Do not underestimate the skills left to Sinners.

mechanics.10.effect.text: Max 100. At Turn Start, gain 1 Defense Level Down per 10 and 1 Fragile per 20.

mechanics.10.response.text: Enemy debuffs gained through failed Prescripts and other effects. Do not disrupt survival preparations just to build stacks.

mechanics.11.effect.text: Speed range +1, Offense/Defense Levels +3, and +1 Poise Potency gained from skills.

mechanics.11.response.text: An Efflorescence buff; distinguish it from normal-form Power and resistances.

mechanics.12.effect.text: Speed range +1, Offense/Defense Levels +2, and +1 Poise Potency/Count gained from skills. Damage increases by 25% plus the percentage of HP lost (max 100%).

mechanics.12.response.text: Use NPC support later while Sinners stop remaining attacks.

mechanics.13.effect.text: Vespa's support intercepts one-sided attacks on allies with no defense skills equipped.

mechanics.13.response.text: Do not clash against attacks left to Assist Defense or equip defense on the targeted Sinner. Also check that the NPC support effect is active that turn.

warnings.0.text: Ryōshū cannot die only while another ally survives. NPC arrival does not permit victory after all Sinners die.

warnings.1.text: Preventing Prescripts adds Onus; it does not stop all buffs.

warnings.2.text: Assist Defense requires no defense skill equipped. Adding Evade or Guard against the one-sided attack can prevent support from activating.

warnings.3.text: “I-I Have to Execute the Prescript Soon...!” disables defense activation. Onus can also make it unredirectable.

warnings.4.text: The Immanent Yearning variant lacks ordinary Annihilate's clash-loss mitigation. Avoid needlessly redirecting attacks meant for the NPC.

preparation.0.text: Recommended Level 60. Level the 4 available Sinners, bringing HP/SP recovery and Attack Power Down. Use Ryōshū's resource generation to recover.

preparation.1.text: SP reduction such as Sinking can help end Efflorescence before Vespa joins. Later, prioritize the SP floor and NPC support conditions.

roles.0.reason.text: Limit hits on the designated target and prevent SP recovery.

roles.1.reason.text: Use survival support to sustain healing and debuffs.
